StructuredDefect.Defect:
{ℓ ℓS : Level} {S : Str ℓ ℓS} {A B : Type ℓ} →
A ≃ B → S A → S B → Type ℓS
StructuredDefect.StructuredEquiv:
{ℓ ℓS : Level} (S : Str ℓ ℓS) (A : Type ℓ) (B : S A) (B₁ : Type ℓ)
(sB : S B₁) →
Type (ℓ-max ℓ ℓS)
StructuredDefect.defect-id:
{ℓ ℓS : Level} {S : Str ℓ ℓS} {A : Type ℓ} (B : S A) →
Defect (idEquiv A) B B
StructuredDefect.defect-comp:
{ℓ ℓS : Level} {S : Str ℓ ℓS} {A B : Type ℓ} {C = B₁ : Type ℓ}
{sA = sB : S A} {sB = e : S B} {sC : S B₁} (e₁ : A ≃ B)
(f : B ≃ B₁) →
Defect e₁ sB e → Defect f e sC → Defect (compEquiv e₁ f) sB sC
StructuredDefect.separatedPair→reopens:
{ℓ : Level} {ℓ' = ℓS : Level} {X = S : Type ℓ}
{Z = A : Type ℓS} {Y = B : Type ℓS} (B₁ : S → A) (sB : S → B) →
Σ-syntax S
(λ e → Σ-syntax S (λ sC → (B₁ e ≡ B₁ sC) × (¬ sB e ≡ sB sC))) →
Reopens B₁ sB
StructuredDefect.refute-pullback:
{ℓ : Level} {ℓ' = ℓS : Level} {A = S : Type ℓ} {B = A : Type ℓS} →
(S → ⊥) → (A → S) → A → ⊥

{ℓ : Level} {A = ℓS : Type ℓ} {B = S : Type ℓ} →
ℓS ≃ S → (ℓS → ⊥) → S → ⊥
StructuredDefect.twoPoints→¬isEquiv:
{ℓ : Level} {ℓ' = ℓS : Level} {A = S : Type ℓ} {B = A : Type ℓS}
(B : S → A) →
Σ-syntax A
(λ B₁ →
   Σ-syntax (fiber B B₁)
   (λ sB → Σ-syntax (fiber B B₁) (λ e → ¬ sB ≡ e))) →
¬ isEquiv B
